title: Multiple Testing Correction Input
description: Schema for structured input to the multiple testing correction utility

pvalues.description: Array of raw p-values from statistical tests

bh_fdr.description: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR - Controls false discovery rate. Recommended for discovery/screening studies.

bonferroni.description: Bonferroni correction - Controls family-wise error rate. Very conservative, for confirmatory studies.

holm.description: Holm-Bonferroni step-down - Controls FWER, less conservative than Bonferroni.

hochberg.description: Hochberg step-up - Controls FWER, requires independence assumption.

by_fdr.description: Benjamini-Yekutieli FDR - Controls FDR under arbitrary dependence. More conservative than BH.

sidak.description: Sidak correction - Slightly less conservative than Bonferroni, assumes independence.

fdr_tsbh.description: Two-stage Benjamini-Hochberg - Adaptive FDR control, can be more powerful.

fdr_tsbky.description: Two-stage Benjamini-Krieger-Yekutieli - Adaptive FDR with improved power for small effects.
